app PurchaseProbe
use std {EmailV1 as Mail} from=deployment.mail
Given
 Receipt {source:text unique, accepted:int min=0, posting:text?}
 policy Receipt read=members
When
 crud Receipt by=members fields=source,accepted
 scenario receive(source:text,accepted:int) -> Receipt by=members
  do
   let previous=first(Receipt as receipt where receipt.source==source order=receipt.id)
   if previous!=null
    require previous.accepted==accepted
    return previous
   create Receipt {source,accepted} as receipt
   send Mail.send {to="recipient@example.test",subject="Receipt posted",body="Original ordered selection"} as delivery
   set receipt {posting=delivery.id}
   return receipt
Then
